description: Source code for model package loader in PyTorch's inductor, handling zip archive extraction, file management, compilation, and model metadata loading.

classes.name: RAIIMinizArchive
classes.description: Helper class for handling zip archive extraction and file listing.

methods.name: load_json_file
methods.description: Loads a JSON file from disk into a nlohmann::json object.

methods.description: Normalizes path separators to '/' and removes duplicate separators.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: create_temp_dir
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary directory path.

methods.name: recursive_mkdir
methods.description: Recursively creates directories for a given path.

methods.name: recursive_rmdir

methods.name: compile_so
